54. Find Position of Number in Array

Problem Statement:
Given a number N,K followed by array of N elements where the difference between any adjacent elements is 1. Find the position of the given number K.If K not found in the array print -1
input_spec: The input consists of two integers N and K, followed by an array of N elements where the difference between any adjacent elements is 1.
output_spec: The output is the position of the given number K. If K is not found in the array, print -1.
